verses.original: שִׁ֥יר הַֽמַּֽעֲל֗וֹת לְדָ֫וִ֥ד לִ֭בִּי לֹא־ גָבַ֣הּ יְהוָ֤ה׀ עֵינַ֑י וְלֹא־ רָמ֣וּ וְלֹֽא־ הִלַּ֓כְתִּי׀ בִּגְדֹל֖וֹת וּבְנִפְלָא֣וֹת מִמֶּֽנִּי׃
verses.transliteration: šîr ham·ma·‘ă·lō·wṯ lə·ḏā·wiḏ lib·bî lō- ḡā·ḇah Yah·weh ‘ê·nay wə·lō- rā·mū wə·lō- hil·laḵ·tî biḡ·ḏō·lō·wṯ ū·ḇə·nip̄·lā·’ō·wṯ mim·men·nî
verses.literal: A song of ascents Of David My heart is not proud O LORD my eyes are not haughty I do not aspire to great things or matters too lofty for me

verses.original: אִם־ לֹ֤א שִׁוִּ֨יתִי׀ וְדוֹמַ֗מְתִּי נַ֫פְשִׁ֥י כְּ֭גָמֻל עֲלֵ֣י אִמּ֑וֹ כַּגָּמֻ֖ל נַפְשִֽׁי׃ עָלַ֣י
verses.transliteration: ’im- lō šiw·wî·ṯî wə·ḏō·w·mam·tî nap̄·šî kə·ḡā·mul ‘ă·lê ’im·mōw kag·gā·mul nap̄·šî ‘ā·lay
verses.literal: Surely . . . I have stilled and quieted my soul like a weaned child . . . with his mother like a weaned child is my soul within me

verses.original: יִ֭שְׂרָאֵל יַחֵ֣ל אֶל־ יְהוָ֑ה מֵֽ֝עַתָּ֗ה וְעַד־ עוֹלָֽם׃
verses.literal: O Israel put your hope in the LORD both now and forevermore . . .
